## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC close and TRA execution

- 2021-12-02: 8-K announces Business Combination Agreement; Form-of TRA embedded as Annex F to the proxy materials (85% sharing of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit from Section 754 basis adjustments on future OpCo unit exchanges plus imputed interest)
- 2022-07-21: De-SPAC closes; ArcLight Clean Transition Corp. II domesticates to Delaware and is renamed OPAL Fuels Inc.; TRA executed with Opal HoldCo LLC (Mendota/Fortistar) as TRA Party Representative
- 2022-07-27: 8-K files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.6

## Explanation

OPAL Fuels Inc. (formerly ArcLight Clean Transition Corp. II) emerged from the July 21, 2022 de-SPAC business combination and executed a Tax Receivable Agreement at closing obligating PubCo to pay 85% of net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on future Exchanges of Opal Fuels LLC Units for Class A or Class C shares, plus imputed interest, to the Mendota/Fortistar-controlled Opal HoldCo as TRA Party Representative and the other named TRA Parties. The contract has not been amended or terminated. OPAL has carried a full valuation allowance against the underlying DTAs since closing and has recognized no TRA liability through FY 2025; the FY 2024 and FY 2025 10-Ks disclose an informational change-of-control estimate of approximately $133.0M discounted ($240.8M undiscounted). See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
